mql-002.front: How do you tell a female California quail?
mql-002.back: Plain grey brown face, small brown plume, no black face or white rim. Same scaled belly (80%).

mql-011.front: BC quail harvest, then and now?
mql-011.back: Up to 4,600 a year in the 1970s, under 1,000 a year recently (65%, BC Outdoors).

mql-012.front: Where in BC did chukar take hold best?
mql-012.back: Low slopes of the Thompson from Kamloops to Lytton; also South Okanagan and Similkameen (65%).

mql-014.back: Nine. They pump air but do not exchange gas (70%, poultry anatomy).

mql-023.front: Early banding study: of 101 quail, how many seen at 1 year?
mql-023.back: 15. Then 4 at two years, 1 at three (60%).

mql-030.front: Does scent control matter for quail?
